original_test_intent: Validate the Error Resolution quantity for each SMBIOS Type 18 record as the diagnostic address range in bytes or the defined Unknown sentinel, consistently related to that record's array/device addresses and retained state across reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 18 records with related Type 16/17/19/20/33 context, preserve the raw resolution and sentinel, bind it to both error addresses and companion fields, validate range arithmetic without inventing precision, and repeat after approved reboot without injecting faults.
manual_activity: A user defines accepted resolution/sentinel and history semantics and approves reboot; no physical action or error generation is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version, resolution units and Unknown sentinel semantics
Expected relationship to Memory Array and Device Error Address
Record freshness/no-record policy and read-only diagnostic context
safety_requirements: Use read-only evidence only; never inject a memory fault to populate resolution.
Do not clear history, modify addressing/ECC policy or manipulate DIMMs.
Preserve raw sentinel and byte units; do not turn Unknown into zero-byte precision.
Check arithmetic for overflow and do not imply finer localization than the encoded range; require reboot approval and no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode each raw resolution/sentinel, correlate both address fields and handles, validate known range arithmetic and Type 33 relevance, and compare pre/post reboot.
Flag contradictions, overflow, stale or changed records without deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve resolution/range, sentinel, address-width and diagnostic-lifecycle policy plus reboot plan.
Assess whether the reported precision is acceptable for the platform and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field name is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot retain the raw Unknown encoding, units, Type 18 handle or relationship to its two error-address fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 16/17/18/19/20/33 data; report per Type 18 handle the raw/normalized resolution, sentinel state, companion addresses, range-validation result, freshness and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 18 Error Resolution scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no synthetic fault is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve the raw Type 18 resolution encoding, decode Unknown versus byte range, correlate it with both error addresses and applicable Type 33 data, validate non-overflowing ranges, and compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS implementations with Type 18 error-resolution records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and mapping versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 18 Error Resolution/address and Type 33 definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw sentinel/units, companion-address binding, range arithmetic and extended-address context.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Finds Unknown-as-zero errors, impossible/overflowed ranges and detached resolution values missed by text grep.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Resolution describes diagnostic localization granularity; it neither proves a current fault nor authorizes fault injection.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept Unknown or platform-specific resolution ranges, but must state the policy; a value cannot be assessed independently of its Type 18 addresses and record lifecycle.
expected_evidence: Approved resolution units/sentinel, address-width and freshness policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/17/18/19/20/33 records and versions
Per-record raw/normalized resolution, companion addresses, handles and range-arithmetic result
Read-only EDAC/kernel/BMC context with no injection or clearing
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot semantic diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Error Resolution is a defined Type 18 field; expected range and diagnostic-history semantics are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Sentinel decoding, address/range validation and persistence comparison are deterministic software work after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw sentinel, units, record identity and companion-address/range validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its no-injection and Type 33 safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Treats missing policy and reboot approval as readiness rather than capability reduction.

review_improvement: Prevents a decoded byte count from passing when it is Unknown, overflowed, detached from its addresses or misread as exact fault precision.
independent_technical_reasoning: Resolution validation is numeric/schema-aware and automatable; the safe interpretation is to preserve diagnostic history rather than manufacture a fault stimulus.
